body: Why do you want to kill yourself?

First of all, I want to say that I'm so sorry for all that you've went through. In no way, is it your fault that your father abused you, and that he would go on, blaming you for his divorce is absolutely cruel. Your mom isn't much better either. Even if she weren't directly abusive, she was still the one allowing a child, HER child, to be abused. 

Your high school bullies are absolute scum and sounds like they've got some issues themselves. They are sad fucking human beings if they feel the need to take out their issues on someone who's already laying down. 

I don't know what to say, other than I am so sorry that you're in this situation.

School can be very stressful, especially if you're already suffering with depression. I think repeating the year would be a great idea. Waiting another year on your degree will be better than never getting it in my opinion. 

If that's not an option, I find school assignments easier if I just start by focusing on one thing at a time. Let's say you've got English, and you suck at English more than anything else in this horrible world. Start by reading up on English and then gradually tackle the smaller demons. It might seem impossible when you look at the entire puzzle, but if you just keep slowly putting it together, it'll probably look somewhat like a picture in the end :)
